title: Points and miles redemption optimizer
description: Research redemption options for a trip, compute point values with a host calculator, and recommend whether to redeem points or pay cash.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: points-miles-optimizer
  title: "Points and miles redemption optimizer"
  description: Research redemption options for a trip, compute point values with a host calculator, and recommend whether to redeem points or pay cash.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Recommend whether points/miles redemption or cash payment is the better value for a given trip, with reasoning.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Trip and loyalty program details
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: Trip details, available loyalty programs, and approximate points/miles balances. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: redemption-researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Redemption options researcher
      role: Researcher on loyalty program redemption options for a trip.
      prompt: Research the redemption options available across the traveler's loyalty programs for this trip, describing typical redemption categories and required point ranges rather than asserting exact current prices or award chart values as fact. Note which figures depend on live availability and should be re-checked close to booking. Cross-check program rules where possible.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, properties: { redemption_options: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, notes_to_recheck: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: point-value-calculator
      kind: tool
      name: Host-resolved point-value calculator
      summary: Deterministic calculator that converts points/miles quantities into an estimated cents-per-point value.
      capabilities: { skills: [], tools: [calculate], permissions: [read-only] }
    - id: redemption-recommendation
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Compare cash price versus points value
      role: Independent evaluator comparing redemption value against paying cash.
      prompt: Compare the calculated points value against the general price range for paying cash, and recommend which is the better use of points for this trip, explaining the reasoning. Avoid asserting a specific cash price as fact; describe it as an estimate to confirm at booking. Flag that redemption values and cash prices can both change and should be reconfirmed close to booking.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [recommendation, reasoning], properties: { recommendation: { type: string, enum: [redeem-points, pay-cash, either] }, reasoning: { type: string } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.6 }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Redemption recommendation
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: redemption-researcher, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: redemption-researcher, to: point-value-calculator, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: point-value-calculator, to: redemption-recommendation, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: redemption-recommendation, to: result, kind: data }
